query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM sentinel_id_pk_rotation_queue
                        WHERE sentinel_id = $1
                            AND decode(
                                    (convert_from(
                                        decode(form_json #>>'{body}', 'base64'),
                                        'utf8'
                                    )::jsonb #>>'{new_pk,key}'),
                                    'hex'
                                ) = $2
                    ) AS "matches_queued!: bool"
